description: Live US airport disruptions from the FAA National Airspace System status: ground stops, ground delay programs (average and max delay), arrival and departure delays with trend, and closures. Pass airports (IATA like JFK or ICAO like KJFK) for a per-airport status (normal, delays, disrupted; general-aviation-only closures are listed as notices) or omit them to get all current events. US airports only. Params: airports (optional list). Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"airports":["JFK","SFO","DEN"]}.
name: airport_status
title: US Airport Status (FAA)
